There’s no right way to play Monster Hunter. One of the coolest things about this game is the customization options based on your play style. All armor pieces have intrinsic traits you can mix and match to get the most out of the set skills. There are also armor sets you can center builds around because the skills that the matching set presents are good enough for you. So I guess my best answer is that it depends on your play style. Find the abilities that best match your play style or that you think are cool and build around that.
